title: Encode a restricted H.263 stream
audience: Students with basic programming competence and prior assembly/MSA experience

environment.byteOrder: both native byte orders in grading
environment.memoryLayout: Student ordinary data below the reserved wide-address grading arena; each domain supplies its documented private stack

progression.localImplementation: Native stage observations and completed feedback; automatic remote enforcement remains pending

prerequisites: MIPS64 calling conventions, full-width addressing and MSA
Bounded file I/O and the earlier image/video chapters
learningObjectives: Build interoperable restricted baseline QCIF H.263 output
Preserve accuracy through selected levels and local reconstruction
Keep accepted reconstructed references separate from raw and staged pictures
Validate complete buffers and publish according to each stated failure contract
Compare finite work, file size and decoded quality independently

functionContract.profile: QCIF planar Y/Cb/Cr input; one initial I and INTER-only P pictures; explicit row GOB headers; bounded full-pixel search; baseline coding without optional annex modes
additionalGates: Full inverse transform Annex A accuracy and exact-zero checks
Independent complete-stream decoding, source quality and local reconstruction comparison
